summary: Brenmiller Energy filed Form 6-K announcing the board's appointment of Nir Brenmiller as CEO, transitioning from former CEO Avi Brenmiller, who remains Chairman. The appointment is effective upon shareholder approval of updated compensation packages for both. Nir Brenmiller, previously Deputy CEO and COO, has been with the company since 2012 and also serves on the board. This is an internal succession, not a forced departure. No deal terms, premium, or stakeholder considerations are disclosed. Watch for shareholder vote timing and approval outcome.
